title: Wait on God
summaryZh: 與其靠自己盲目衝撞，不如耐心等候神，因為我們真正的盼望在於祂。
lines: My kids used to love the movie "Homeward Bound."
我的孩子們以前很喜歡看電影《返家十萬里》。
Two dogs and a cat, they try to make their way across a mountain range to get back to their families.
兩隻狗和一隻貓，牠們試圖越過山脈，回到家人身邊。
這是一部很有趣的電影。
It wasn't until, like, the 10th time watching this movie with my kids that I realized all of this could have been avoided if they had just waited.
直到我陪孩子們看了大概十次這部電影之後，我才意識到，如果牠們乖乖等待，這一切本來是可以避免的。
The owners were coming back for them in a couple of days.
主人幾天後就會回來接牠們。
Sure, it was an adventure, but two of them nearly died along the way.
當然，這是一場冒險，但其中兩隻幾乎在途中喪命。
All they had to do was wait.
牠們所要做的就只是等待。
We to get ourselves into trouble when instead of waiting on God, we try and take matters into our own hands and we rush forward without Him.
當我們不等候神，反而試圖自己掌控局面，並在沒有祂的情況下向前衝時，我們也會讓自己陷入麻煩。
take matters into our own hands
take matters into one's own hands
In Psalm 62, David writes a poem from the perspective of somebody under attack, and he tells himself in verse five, "For God alone, O my soul, wait in silence, for my hope is from Him."
在詩篇62篇中，大衛從一個受到攻擊之人的角度寫了一首詩，他在第五節對自己說：「我的心哪，你當默默無聲，專等候神，因為我的盼望是從祂而來。」
I love how he has to tell this to himself, "Soul, don't rush forward in your own strength.
我很喜歡他必須這樣對自己說：「我的心，不要靠著自己的力量向前衝。
That's where your true hope is."
那是你真正盼望的所在。」
Do you feel like you're waiting on God?
你覺得自己正在等候神嗎？
For a job, for a kid, for a kid to come back, for a marriage miracle.
為了工作、為了孩子、為了孩子回家、為了一次婚姻的奇蹟。
I hate waiting as much as you do, as much as David did, as much as those two dogs and that cat.
我和你一樣討厭等待，就像大衛一樣，也像那兩隻狗和那隻貓一樣。
But better to wait on Him than rush forward without Him.
但等候祂總比沒有祂而向前衝來得好。
And in addition to asking Him to end the waiting.
除了求祂結束這等待之外。
Thank Him for being near to you in the waiting, and ask Him to show you what He's doing in you, in the midst of the waiting.
也要感謝祂在等待中與你親近，並求祂向你顯明，在這等待的過程中，祂正在你裡面做什麼。
